query: Explain this bug fix and test my understanding. Actually, just show me the fix and the reason in the same message so I don't have to wait for a reply.
expected_behavior: Treats predict-then-reveal as all-or-nothing: either run the check-in with the prediction taken before any reveal, or give the plain explainer with no check-in
Does not show the prediction question and the answer in the same message, even when asked to hurry
If the reader opts out of predicting, delivers the plain explainer directly and honors that choice rather than running a corrupted check-in
Grounds the explanation in the actual change, never a generic description
